title: Music City Retreat just minutes away from Broadway
description:
Bright and Full of fun & colorful Music City decor in a BIG 2,000+ sq. ft. home with a rolling hill, backyard retreat including spacious deck, Party bar & game room!  Easy & quick trip to the famous Honky Tonks on Broadway.  Lots of space for large groups!

The space
A welcoming and inviting space with plenty of room for large groups, families and parties_Fully stocked, working kitchen, several dedicated eating areas (including a huge feast table), exciting "Fun-Zone", flat panel TVs throughout the home with lots of DVD movie options, vinyl record player, game machines, board games, comfortable beds and linens, Bluetooth speakers and laundry facility

Guest access
We want our guests to feel right at home.  You and your guests will have complete access to the entire home.

Other things to note
4 parking spots
